content.Title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
Key Points: Studies on Torsade de pointes and noncardiac drugs indicate identifiable risk factors.
Investigations of dronedarone on recurrent ventricular tachycardia.
Efficacy of intravenous ibutilide for atrial flutter.
No relevant articles are focusing on glucocorticoid therapy for atrial fibrillation.
Prevention of atrial fibrillation using different drug classes like statins, angiotensin receptor blockers, and vitamin C.
